title: TOPN with a tie at the N-th row returns the whole tie, here 5 rows for N = 4

source.quote: If there is a tie, in Order_By values, at the N-th row of the table, then all tied rows are returned.
source.supports: ties at the N-th row are all returned

derivation: Player scores: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, Dee 70, Eve 70, Fay 50. Descending: 90, 80, 80, 70, 70, 50. The fourth row (70) ties with the fifth, so 5 rows are returned. The tie of Bob and Cho lies inside the first four and adds nothing.
